name: Recover it!
title: D. Recover it!
input_spec:
The first line of the input contains one integer n (1≤n≤2⋅105) — the number of elements in a.

The second line of the input contains 2n integers b1,b2,…,b2n (2≤bi≤2750131), where bi is the i-th element of b. 2750131 is the 199999-th prime number.
output_spec: In the only line of the output print n integers a1,a2,…,an (2≤ai≤2⋅105) in any order — the array a from which the array b can be obtained using the sequence of moves given in the problem statement. If there are multiple answers, you can print any.
